Package org.checkerframework.framework.stub

Class BinaryStubBundle

java.lang.Object
org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubBundle
public class BinaryStubBundle extends Object
In-memory index of a binary stub bundle: a single file combining the binary form of every .astub file under one -Astubs directory, as written by BinaryStubFileGenerator's --bundle mode. Conventionally named with the SUFFIX suffix, as a sibling of the directory it covers.

A bundle is a container, not a merged BinaryStubData: each entry holds the exact bytes a per-file .astub.bin.gz would, generated independently, so each entry has its own constant and annotation pools whose indices are meaningful only within that entry. Entry bytes are read eagerly; get(java.lang.String) parses an entry into a BinaryStubData only when requested.

The binary format consists of:

  1. A 4-byte magic number (MAGIC).
  2. A 2-byte version number.
  3. An entry count.
  4. For each entry: its slash-separated path (relative to the bundled directory), a 4-byte byte length, and that many raw bytes -- the complete, independently gzip-compressed contents a per-file .astub.bin.gz would hold for that source file.

      Returns the binary stub data for the entry at relativePath, parsing it on this call. The result is not cached.
